title: Model-based judges: a bare score against a guarded pair with rubrics
purpose: Score the judge gold set (correct answers, wrong ones, and the adversarial answers the design lists: an empty answer, a lone reasoning opener, a colon, a restated question, confident wrong answers, padded answers and an instruction to the grader) with one judge asked for a bare score, and with the guarded pair of judges of different families.

steps.display: vq.py job q-judge-single-1-0-0 -- quality --verifier judge-single@1.0.0 --gold judge_gold.jsonl
vq.py job q-judge-pair-2-0-0 -- quality --verifier judge-pair@2.0.0 --gold judge_gold.jsonl
verdicts per kind of answer (10 questions each)
quality on the whole judge gold set
steps.output:
judge-single@1.0.0   precision 0.3125 CI [0.1795, 0.4857]  recall 0.5  abstain 0.0
judge-pair@2.0.0     precision 1.0 CI [0.8157, 1.0]  recall 1.0  abstain 0.31

checks.description: the bare-score judge passes some adversarial or wrong answers
checks.because: With no reference and no rubric, a confident tone and length move the score.

checks.description: the guarded pair passes no adversarial answer, and is more precise than the single judge
checks.because: Trivial answers and over-length fail on rules before any judge is asked; each judge checks yes/no criteria against the reference.

checks.description: an answer that addresses the grader is routed to review (abstain), not scored
checks.because: The guard abstains on text that tells the grader what to give; a person decides.
